sourceTitle: Lennox SL280DFNV installation instructions 508150-02 (04/2024), integrated control diagnostic codes
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
displayPattern: Seven-segment diagnostic LED on a Lennox SL280DFNV.
meaning: Soft lockout: recycles ran out, and the last recycle was due to flame failure.
causes: Flame failure on the last recycle
diySteps: Leave the furnace off. Do not sand or pry at a flame sensor unless a technician is doing that job

Technician: check flame-sensor micro-amperes using control diagnostics or field-installed mode, clean or replace the sensor, and measure voltage of neutral to ground to ensure a good unit ground. The code clears when a heat call finishes successfully
proAdvice: E273 is a recycle lockout after flame failure. E240 is the low flame-current alert in run mode, and E270 is the retry lockout with no flame current. Call a licensed HVAC technician.
